description: Minimal digital twin profile for Phase A Non-RT RIC + A1 conformance testing. Includes production Non-RT RIC, A1 peer simulator, and info-source simulator with deterministic modes.
purpose: Phase A baseline: deterministic end-to-end testing with repeatable evidence capture
conformance_scope: TS 103 987 section 6 and Annex A (A1 API contract)
TS 103 988 sections 5-9 (A1 data model and EI clause coverage)
seed_comment: Deterministic reproducibility: use seed 42 for all test runs in Phase A

components.description: Non-RT RIC + A1 producer implementation under test

components.role: Test Peer (A1 Policy Consumer / A1-EI Consumer)
components.description: Deterministic simulator for A1 consumer-side interactions. Accepts policy and EI job operations, generates lifecycle transitions, sends callbacks.

components.interface: A1-EI (EI job result delivery, status notifications)
components.description: Simulates external information sources that provide enrichment data for Non-RT RIC. Generates deterministic EI job results and status notifications.

component_activation_rules.description: A1-P conformance tests require Non-RT RIC and A1 peer consumer simulator
A1-EI conformance tests require Non-RT RIC, peer consumer, and info-source simulators
API contract tests require Non-RT RIC and peer simulator for payload validation

data_seed_manifest.description: Data initialization for deterministic test runs

validation_checklist: [ ] Non-RT RIC is running and A1 endpoints are accessible
[ ] A1 peer simulator module loads without errors
[ ] Info sources simulator module loads without errors
[ ] Policy type catalog contains expected 8 types
[ ] Simulator state is reset (no stale policies or EI jobs)
[ ] Seed 42 is set for all deterministic components
[ ] Artifact directories exist and are writable
[ ] pytest can discover and collect test suites

exit_criteria.phase_a_gate_open: All selected conformance suites executed with published verdict summary
exit_criteria.no_unresolved_failures: Every failing test either has a fix + passing rerun or approved deferred action
exit_criteria.simulator_bom_published: Minimal simulator BOM documented and validated with successful full rerun
exit_criteria.repeatability_verified: At least one successful repeat run from same twin profile + selectors
